text.fallback: Go to the Ender Chest in the middle of Spark Island and open it.
Click the Christmas Island entry (“Weihnachtsinsel”). It shows what the island wishes for right now.
Put wished-for items in the window and close it. Everything else comes back to you.
When a stage is full, everyone gets 3 potions. If your inventory was full, right-click the Christmas Island entry to collect them.
